entries.observation: ADCS takes two width-selected registers and PSTATE.C, calls AddWithCarry, writes destination and NZCV. ADDS shifted-register uses carry input zero; omitted shift defaults to LSL zero.
entries.access: Primary indexed entry text; not full-document retrieval.

entries.observation: LSLV reduces the second operand modulo register width; LSL register is an alias. REV reverses byte order for32/64-bit selected forms; operation reverses8-bit groups.
entries.access: Primary indexed entry text. Full PDF open rejected as15314151bytes; no local download.

entries.observation: Writing a W destination clears the upper half of the corresponding X register. S variants update arithmetic flags; ADD does not. N/Z/C/V mean negative/zero/carry/overflow.

Early out separates prewritten output from inputs; lateout permits reuse only after all input reads. Probe blocks declare outputs and flag effects and restrict themselves to register/flag instructions.
